judgements.reason: Conformal mapping's L0-L4 summits already exist as sorry-free named theorems in TauCeti (riemannMapping, montel, rouche, hurwitz, monodromy_theorem), leaving only the Caratheodory closure homeomorphism and the Schwarz-Christoffel bijection; quiver representations still needs the converse of Gabriel's dichotomy with the indecomposable-to-positive-root bijection, Gabriel's presentation theorem with the Ext-quiver and Morita reduction, and the existence of almost-split sequences with the AR quiver.

Profinite cohomology imports no other roadmap and already has ~700 declarations, so what is left is four self-contained layers (all-degree cohomology, cd_p, the all-degree cup product, the Evens norm) plus Hilbert 90 and Kummer; logic and definability must build valued-field quantifier elimination, p-adic and motivic integration, MRDP and o-minimality with Pila-Wilkie, and its LD.3 imports Grothendieck rings through MotivesAndAlgebraicCycles MC.4, dragging in the entirely absent spectra-and-higher-K-theory column.

Sieve methods is one deep analytic column (Brun's sieve and the fundamental lemma, both large sieves, Bombieri-Vinogradov, Maynard) built on Mathlib's SelbergSieve carrier and Dirichlet-character machinery; logic must build a valued-field model theory that does not exist, definable and motivic integration, MRDP, and o-minimal cell decomposition with Pila-Wilkie, on top of the imported motives and higher K-theory.

Sieve methods starts from Mathlib's SelbergSieve/BoundingSieve and Dirichlet L-theory and imports only AnalyticNumberTheory's four stages; automorphic forms has no automorphicForm, (g,K)-module, moderate-growth or Siegel-set declaration at all and additionally needs smooth representations of p-adic groups, the topology on G(E) and Weil restriction, adelic algebraic groups, modular curves as schemes and the Hilbert/Quot-scheme moduli layer.

Both must build roughly forty stages of absent theory, but automorphic forms stacks more distinct missing areas: (g,K)-modules with Frechet globalizations, van Est, Siegel-set decay and tensor factorization sit on top of smooth p-adic representation theory, Weil restriction, modular curves as schemes and the moduli/stack layer, whereas K-theory's gap is a single (equally absent) stable-homotopy foundation plus the Q- and S-constructions over TauCeti's existing ExactK0 and exact-category API.

General algebraic K-theory rests on a stable-homotopy foundation neither library has - no spectra, no plus construction, no Steinberg group or K2 - and imports KTheoryLowDegrees, K2SymbolsBrauer and K3BlochGroups before its own Q- and S-constructions, about forty stages in all; reductive groups Part II imports a single upstream stage and builds buildings, parahorics and the decompositions directly on TauCeti's ~4900 algebraic-group and ~3200 root-system declarations.

Reductive groups Part II is seven unbuilt layers over an existing root-datum and local-field base with one imported stage; Neron models has nothing at all (no NeronModel, AbelianScheme or TateModule declaration) and its R11.3 and R11.5 import abelian schemes, formal and rigid geometry and PadicHodgeTheory R06.6, bringing the crystalline/prismatic/perfectoid comparison tower with them - about 130 imported stages against one.

Small ramification consumes Neron models R11.6 outright as an input and then adds Tate/Serre mod-2 and mod-3 nonexistence, Fontaine's everywhere-good-reduction theorem, Schoof's theorem with the classification of finite flat group schemes over Z[1/p], and the ordinary-lifting and potential-modularity inputs R21.6 and R24.6.

Diamond etale cohomology lies inside small ramification's own import closure (through potential modularity and the etale-duality chain into AdicCoefficientsAndComparisons and C2), and small ramification then adds Neron models, finite flat group schemes with their ramification theory, Faltings finiteness, the modularity-lifting tower and its own five nonexistence theorems.

Geometric Satake consumes DiamondEtaleCohomology and the diamond six operations as verified inputs (GS0:Schubert-smoothness requires DiamondSixOperations S4, which requires C9), and then needs the relative Fargues-Fontaine curve, BunG, the affine Grassmannian and its Witt-vector form with Bhatt-Scholze projectivity, fusion, the decomposition theorem and the integral Tannakian reconstruction, plus buildings and parahorics from RG2.

Both stand on the same absent perfectoid/diamond tower, but p-adic local Langlands additionally needs Robba rings and (phi,Gamma)-modules (no such declaration in either library), p-adic Hodge theory, admissible Banach and locally analytic representation theory, Colmez's functor and Paskunas' block theory, and its normalization against classical local Langlands pulls in the automorphic and endoscopic machinery - about 250 imported stages at depth 21 against Satake's 190 at depth 15.

AutomorphicFormsOnReductiveGroups sits inside p-adic local Langlands' import closure (R30.1 needs GL2 local Langlands R16.3, which reaches AF.1 through the L-function stages), and p-adic local Langlands then adds Robba rings and (phi,Gamma)-modules, p-adic Hodge theory, Colmez's functor and the block/deformation-ring comparisons on top.

Logic can start from Mathlib's ModelTheory (languages, ultraproducts with Los, ACF) and Dioph, and its heaviest import is the motives/K-theory column, about forty upstream stages; diamond etale cohomology has almost no base - no diamond, v-stack, perfectoid space or perverse sheaf exists - and must build adic/perfectoid foundations, v-stacks, the enhanced left-complete derived sheaf theory and classical adic etale cohomology before its own ten ECD stages, about a hundred imported stages.

K-theory's missing tower is spectra plus the Q- and S-constructions over an existing exact-category and ExactK0 base, about forty stages; geometric Satake needs the whole perfectoid/diamond/Fargues-Fontaine column with the diamond six operations, perverse sheaves and the decomposition theorem, Bhatt-Scholze projectivity of the Witt Grassmannian and Bruhat-Tits parahorics before its own fusion and Tannakian layers, about two hundred stages.

Reductive groups Part II imports a single upstream stage and builds on TauCeti's existing root data, tori and local fields; p-adic local Langlands imports RG2 itself (through smooth representations of local groups) plus roughly 250 further stages including p-adic Hodge theory, (phi,Gamma)-modules over the Robba ring and GL2 local Langlands, before its own six layers.

Profinite cohomology imports no roadmap and has ~700 declarations already built, leaving four layers of homological bookkeeping (all-degree cohomology, cd_p, the graded cup product, the Evens norm) plus Hilbert 90 and Kummer; sieve methods must build Brun's sieve and the fundamental lemma, both large sieves with Vaughan's identity, Bombieri-Vinogradov and Maynard's bounded gaps, on top of the zero-free-region and explicit-formula stages of AnalyticNumberTheory that are themselves absent.

Every Neron-model layer is unbuilt and R11.3/R11.5 import abelian schemes, formal-rigid geometry and PadicHodgeTheory R06.6 with its crystalline, prismatic and perfectoid tower - about 130 imported stages at depth 16; automorphic forms builds on real adelic, modular-form, Hecke and Lie infrastructure and imports about a third as much (36 stages at depth 7).

Geometric Satake's stack is the perfectoid/diamond/Fargues-Fontaine column of about 190 imported stages; small ramification's is roughly two and a half times larger (about 450 stages at depth 27) and contains the diamond etale-cohomology and six-operations machinery inside it, plus Neron models, finite flat group schemes, Faltings finiteness and the whole modularity-lifting chain, before its own Fontaine and Schoof nonexistence theorems.

Conformal mapping's summits are already sorry-free in TauCeti (riemannMapping, montel, rouche, monodromy_theorem) and only the boundary homeomorphism and the Schwarz-Christoffel bijection remain; profinite cohomology still needs Hilbert 90 and the Kummer isomorphism plus four stacked layers - all-degree continuous cohomology, cohomological dimension, the all-degree graded cup product on the coinduction resolution, and the Evens norm.

DiamondEtaleCohomology is itself an import of p-adic local Langlands (reached from R30.1 through GL2 local Langlands and the etale-duality chain), which then adds Robba rings and (phi,Gamma)-modules, p-adic Hodge theory, admissible Banach and locally analytic categories, Colmez's functor and the Paskunas/Hu-Tan/Tung block results.
